initialUserIntent: Complete the Java build/run/debug part of JetBrains-style IDE management: build (compile) and run a Java workspace, presenting build/run status and output honestly, with debug deferred if the engine lacks a debug capability. Current state: the IDE has NO Java build/run/debug (java_language.rs is a language service only; RefactorKit engine real_engine.rs has scan/symbols/definition/references/diagnostics/refactoring only, no build/run/debug). The RefactorKit tool has a Kotlin/JVM build-model projection (build.gradle.kts, build model/source-set provider contract, workspace/executeCommand, buildSymbols) but no build/run/debug execution. This slice makes Java build/run operational in the IDE by consuming the RefactorKit build model + a real build/run execution path, with honest-unavailable when the capability is absent.

approvedChanges.statement: Pi is, in the future, ONE of the usable agents in the IDE, not the sole AI/model authority.
User authorized RefactorKit as a PRODUCT FEATURE. Java TEST infra (JavaSpec/Maven/JUnit/dataset) and Java-only RefactorKit rules as workflow refactoring authority remain EXCLUDED.

No standalone Java Project Model Kit. Project-model capabilities remain internal, modular RefactorKit components, extracted later only if independent external consumers and a stable reusable contract emerge.

requirement.title: Java build and run presented in the IDE via RefactorKit
requirement.classification: Story BDD + Spec BDD for pure view-model decisions
requirement.capability: Build (compile) and run a Java workspace, presenting build/run status and output honestly. Consumes the RefactorKit build model (Kotlin/JVM build-model projection) + a real build/run execution path behind the engine, with honest-unavailable when the capability is absent or the build/run fails. Debug is deferred (engine lacks a debug capability) and recorded honestly.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given a Java workspace, the IDE requests the RefactorKit build capability and presents the build status/output (compile) honestly.
Given a successful build, the IDE requests the RefactorKit run capability and presents the run status/output honestly; debug is recorded as deferred/unavailable if absent.
Given the build/run capability is absent or the build/run fails, the IDE reports honest unavailable/error and never fabricates build/run output.
Boundary invariant: packages/ui, packages/web-core, apps/web never import @tauri-apps/api; browser/Tauri build/run implementations live behind frontend ports.
Status is evidence-based with an explicit state, never inferred from shells; live Tauri-window build/run E2E may remain unvalidated if headless (recorded honestly).

requirement.owner: bdd-ts-domain-expert (domain research) + bdd-ts-gherkin-writer (feature) + ts-story-driven (Story) + tauri-rust-coder (engine build/run) + tauri-adapter-coder + browser-adapter-coder + frontend-core-coder/frontend-app-coder (view-model + controller wiring)
requirement.scope: Java build (compile) + run presented in the IDE by consuming the RefactorKit build model + a real build/run execution path. Debug deferred (engine lacks debug capability, recorded honestly). The existing Java language service, navigation, project-model, refactoring, engine-integration slices stay as-is.
exclusions: JavaSpec, Maven, JUnit-specific policy, Java datasets as workflow test infra
Java-only RefactorKit rules as the workflow's own refactoring authority
Standalone Java Project Model Kit (prior decision: stays inside RefactorKit)
Java debug (deferred; engine lacks debug capability)
openQuestions: Source: whether the build/run comes from a new RefactorKit engine build/run command (real_engine.rs) or a Java build tool (javac/Java toolchain) behind the engine — confirm the primary source.
Scope: build (compile) only, or build+run — confirm run is in scope for this slice.
Debug: confirm debug is deferred (engine lacks debug capability) and recorded honestly.
Editor wiring: whether build/run presentation is proven wired into a live panel or a desktop-harness renderer is acceptable evidence.
